title: Mochizuki Honami — What I Couldn't Say〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: Our Starry Sky Leading to the Future

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Do we all have a drink ready?

rows.Speaker: Rin & Saki
rows.Line: Yup♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're all set.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Same here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Here's to the release of Leo/need's debut CD!

rows.Speaker: Honami, Saki, Ichika & Shiho
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Mmm!
You've just gotta have an orange juice after becoming a pro musician!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Didn't you drink the same thing while we were writing that song?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, I remember you drinking orange juice during lunch yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, why am I getting the third degree all of a sudden?! Let's just enjoy the party!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Our CD's been released...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (So much happened after Mr. Shindo reached out to us.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We did that solo show and our Thank You Show, then I became the leader of Leo/need...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It's already been a long journey, but the days have also gone by so fast.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Honami...?
What's got you grinning like that? Also, you're all by yourself over here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? Did my grin look that funny?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Well, I can't say.
But we can try finding someone else who also saw.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, there you go teasing me again...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sorry...
You just looked really happy is all, so I thought I'd ask.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, so...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hona! Stop!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You gotta save that for the interview♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, Ms. Hona, as the leader of Leo/need, how do you feel right now?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-You're interviewing me?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Is that plastic bottle supposed to be your microphone?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Also, Ms. Hona...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Why don't we let her continue?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Actually, I've been wanting to ask you all the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Would you mind playing along for a bit, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: O-Okay.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, how I feel right now?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was actually just thinking about all the things that happened after Mr. Shindo discovered us...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We threw everything we had at our solo show in order to get our big chance, and I remember being so nervous when I was filling in our contract with my mom...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Those things feel like they happened just yesterday, but now our song's being played all throughout Shibuya.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
The thought of that excited me so much.
It's like we've really accomplished something, and I can kind of feel proud of what we've done.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, that's why...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I feel really happy!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's perfect, Hona! Nice job♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Alright, next!
Sakki, our eyes just met, so you're up!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
W-Wait, what?!
There's no way I can follow that interview!

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line:
Haha.
Hehe.
